reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reviews agent actions before execution and performs independent read-only reviews of delivered changes, with configurable rules and approval or remediation prompts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供执行前规则拦截和交付时独立只读审查，以检查智能体操作与变更。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with pre-execution rule interception and independent read-only delivery reviews for agent actions and changes.

capabilities: Pre-execution interception of write, edit, bash, and read actions
Local rule checks for secrets, dangerous commands, and sensitive paths
Read-only subagent review of agent changes at delivery time
Approval prompts and review outcomes that can affect agent execution
